notes: Mosaic grid of 4 'Collection Card / Editorial / Desktop' instances (1 large 708x885 + 2 small 342x430 + 1 wide 708x431) laid out as a bento/mosaic, not a uniform grid. Each card = full-bleed collection image with overlaid index label (N.º 0X, top-left), bottom-left label block (collection heading + piece-count caption), and a square 40px Arrow Button (Icon/arrow-right) bottom-right. Library-instance based (cards + ArrowButtonSquare atom reused). multiScheme=true: the SAME vars resolve to two modes across cards — Essential/Foreground Heading = #fffefd on dark cards (1,3) vs #1e1b18 on light cards (2,4); Essential/Foreground = #faf7f2 (dark) vs #2a2620 (light); Essential/Foreground Chip = rgba(255,254,253,0.08) (dark) vs rgba(30,27,24,0.08) (light). Card 3 heading/caption resolve to var(--black,#000000). No section-level heading/eyebrow/button — all text lives inside the cards. Desktop node only; mobile likely stacks the mosaic. Reported bg/fg use the outer container + first/primary card heading.
